records.jp: 間違いない、二人の想いを感じる
records.en_original: No doubt. I can feel their emotions.
records.en: No doubt. I can feel their emotions.

records.jp: あたしと亜未琉は小さいころからいつも一緒で、<CR>ありていに言うなら、幼馴染の関係だ
records.en_original: Amiru and I have always been together since we were little. Simply put, we're childhood friends.
records.en: Amiru and I have always been together since we were little. Simply put, we're childhood friends.

records.jp: それがいつの間にか、親友、妹……
records.en_original: Somehow, before I knew it, she became my best friend, my little sister...
records.en: Somehow, before I knew it, she became my best friend, my little sister...

records.jp: いや違う
records.en_original: No, that's not it.
records.en: No, that's not it.

records.jp: あたしにとって、亜未流は言葉では言い表せない<CR>存在になっていった
records.en_original: To me, Amiru became someone I couldn't simply describe in words.
records.en: To me, Amiru became someone I couldn't simply describe in words.

records.jp: なのに……
records.en_original: And yet...
records.en: And yet...

records.jp: あたしは無邪気にし過ぎた
records.en_original: I was so immature.
records.en: I was so immature.

records.jp: 亜未琉がどんな気持ちでいたか、<CR>もっと思いやれていたら……
records.en_original: If only I'd thought more about how Amiru felt...
records.en: If only I'd thought more about how Amiru felt...

records.jp: もっと早くに手を差し伸べられていたら、<CR>フラグメントを抜かれることはなかったのに
records.en_original: If only I'd reached out to her sooner, maybe her Fragment wouldn't have been stolen.
records.en: If only I'd reached out to her sooner, maybe her Fragment wouldn't have been stolen.

records.jp: 私は、大切な想いを手放した
records.en_original: I let go of something precious to me.
records.en: I let go of something precious to me.

records.jp: 小さい頃から思っていた
records.en_original: I've thought this way since I was little.
records.en: I've thought this way since I was little.

records.jp: 涼楓はまるで、もう一人の自分みたいだと
records.en_original: Ryoka seemed like another me.
records.en: Ryoka seemed like another me.

records.jp: 一緒にいると気が合って、<CR>彼女の中に、沢山同じ想いを見つけた
records.en_original: We got along so well, and deep down, I found so many feelings we shared.
records.en: We got along so well, and deep down, I found so many feelings we shared.

records.jp: 私の彼女への想いは、友情でも家族でもない、<CR>特別なものになっていった
records.en_original: What I felt for her wasn't just friendship or family. It became something special.
records.en: What I felt for her wasn't just friendship or family. It became something special.

records.jp: けど……涼楓の気持ちは、違った
records.en_original: But... Ryoka felt differently.
records.en: But... Ryoka felt differently.

records.jp: 私との関係を大切に想っているからこそ、<CR>今の関係を壊したくないというのが、涼楓の気持ち
records.en_original: Because she treasured our relationship, she didn't want to risk ruining what we had. That's how Ryoka felt.
records.en: Because she treasured our relationship, she didn't want to risk ruining what we had. That's how Ryoka felt.

records.jp: だから、私は――
records.en_original: So, I—
records.en: So, I—

records.jp: 涼楓への想いを捨てることを選んだ
records.en_original: I chose to let go of my feelings for Ryoka.
records.en: I chose to let go of my feelings for Ryoka.

records.jp: これからも、涼楓とずっと一緒にいるために……
records.en_original: So that we could always be together...
records.en: So that we could always be together...

records.jp: 抜かれたフラグメントは戻らない。<CR>けれど、あたしは力を得ることができた
records.en_original: The Fragments that were taken won't come back, but I gained strength.
records.en: The Fragments that were taken won't come back, but I gained strength.

records.jp: あたしが亜未琉に対して犯した、過ちを正す力を
records.en_original: The strength to right my wrongs with Amiru.
records.en: The strength to right my wrongs with Amiru.

records.jp: 亜未琉に対する、本当の自分の想いに背を向け、<CR>亜未琉の気持ちを見て見ぬふりして、想いを殺した
records.en_original: I turned away from my real feelings for Amiru—ignored how she felt—and stifled those emotions.
records.en: I turned away from my real feelings for Amiru—ignored how she felt—and stifled those emotions.

records.jp: あたしはその後悔を、力に変える。<CR>どんな卑しい想いからも、逃げはしない
records.en_original: I'll turn that regret into strength. No matter how ugly those feelings are, I won't run away anymore.
records.en: I'll turn that regret into strength. No matter how ugly those feelings are, I won't run away anymore.

records.jp: 失った涼楓への想いは、今も私の中にはない
records.en_original: The feelings I lost for Ryoka still aren't within me.
records.en: The feelings I lost for Ryoka still aren't within me.

records.jp: けれど、途切れていたはずの私の心が、<CR>また動き出したように感じる
records.en_original: But, I feel like my heart, which should have gone silent, is starting to move again.
records.en: But, I feel like my heart, which should have gone silent, is starting to move again.

records.jp: だから私は、私のために選択してくれた涼楓と一緒に<CR>罪を犯す道を選んだ
records.en_original: That's why I chose to walk the same path of sin with Ryoka, who made her choice for me.
records.en: That's why I chose to walk the same path of sin with Ryoka, who made her choice for me.

records.jp: コモンの扉を開くため、大勢の少女たちから<CR>フラグメントを抜く道を
records.en_original: To open the door to the Common, we chose to steal Fragments from many girls.
records.en: To open the door to the Common, we chose to steal Fragments from many girls.

records.jp: けれど、けしてそれは不幸なんかじゃない
records.en_original: But ultimately, it wasn't an unhappy road to go down.
records.en: But ultimately, it wasn't an unhappy road to go down.

records.jp: だって
records.en_original: Because...
records.en: Because...

records.jp: 大事なあなたが、共に歩んでくれるから
records.en_original: ...someone precious to me was walking that road with me.
records.en: ...someone precious to me was walking that road with me.

records.jp: 大事なあなたが、共に歩んでくれるから
records.en_original: ...someone precious to me was walking that road with me.
records.en: ...someone precious to me was walking that road with me.

records.jp: なくした想いは心の途切れ……。<CR>きっと、すごい喪失感だと思う
records.en_original: Losing your emotions is like having your heart split in two. I'm sure there's an overwhelming feeling of loss.
records.en: Losing your emotions is like having your heart split in two. I'm sure there's an overwhelming feeling of loss.

records.jp: うん……けど、抜かれたフラグメントを戻せば、<CR>元通りにできる
records.en_original: Yeah...but, if we return the stolen Fragments, things can go back to normal.
records.en: Yeah...but, if we return the stolen Fragments, things can go back to normal.

records.jp: その証拠に、モモさんは想いを取り戻して<CR>目覚めることができたんだから
records.en_original: Just look at Momo—she got her emotions back and was able to wake up again.
records.en: Just look at Momo—she got her emotions back and was able to wake up again.

records.jp: お姉ちゃんの想いが、モモさんの想いを蘇らせる。<CR>だからきっと、涼楓さんだって……
records.en_original: My sister's feelings revived Momo's heart. So I'm sure Ryoka can recover too...
records.en: My sister's feelings revived Momo's heart. So I'm sure Ryoka can recover too...

records.jp: うん。美弦さんも言ってた
records.en_original: Yeah. Mio said so as well.
records.en: Yeah. Mio said so as well.

records.jp: 美弦さんがモモさんの想いを取り戻したように、<CR>涼楓さんも、亜未琉さんの想いを取り戻せるか……
records.en_original: Just like Mio got Momo's emotions back, maybe Ryoka can get Amiru's emotions back, too...
records.en: Just like Mio got Momo's emotions back, maybe Ryoka can get Amiru's emotions back, too...

records.jp: そう聞かれた時に、涼楓さんならできるって言ってた。<CR>美弦さんが言うんだから、多分、そうなんだと思う
records.en_original: When she was asked about it, Mio said Ryoka could do it. If Mio thinks so, then I believe it too.
records.en: When she was asked about it, Mio said Ryoka could do it. If Mio thinks so, then I believe it too.

records.jp: そっか……そうだね。<CR>お姉ちゃんが言うなら、間違いないよ
records.en_original: I see... You're right. If my sister says so, then it must be true.
records.en: I see... You're right. If my sister says so, then it must be true.

records.jp: けど、想いを戻す方法があるからといって、<CR>それを奪うのが良くないことには変わりない
records.en_original: But just because there's a way to return feelings and emotions doesn't mean it's okay to steal them in the first place.
records.en: But just because there's a way to return feelings and emotions doesn't mean it's okay to steal them in the first place.

records.jp: だね……だからそんな想い、誰にもさせちゃいけない。<CR>私たちで守らない、と……
records.en_original: Right... That's why we can't ever let anyone feel that way. We need to protect everyone's feelings.
records.en: Right... That's why we can't ever let anyone feel that way. We need to protect everyone's feelings.

records.jp: うん……あっ
records.en_original: Yeah... Oh—
records.en: Yeah... Oh—

records.jp: 涼楓さんたちみたいな想いはさせられない。<CR>だから、私たちは……
records.en_original: We can't let anyone feel the way Ryoka and the others did. That's why...
records.en: We can't let anyone feel the way Ryoka and the others did. That's why...

records.jp: みんなの想いを守るため。<CR>この世界を、終わらせないために……
records.en_original: We have to protect everyone's feelings. To keep this world from ending.
records.en: We have to protect everyone's feelings. To keep this world from ending.

records.jp: ううん、でも紫乃ちゃんの創る世界でも、<CR>そんな想いはしなくてすむから……
records.en_original: But, in the world Shino creates, you wouldn't have to feel that way either.
records.en: But, in the world Shino creates, you wouldn't have to feel that way either.

records.jp: ……どうしよう、瑠夏ちゃん。<CR>私、どっちも間違ってない気持ちになってきたかも
records.en_original: ...What should we do, Ruka? I'm starting to see the merits of both sides.
records.en: ...What should we do, Ruka? I'm starting to see the merits of both sides.

records.jp: 私も同じ……一番最悪な状況かもしれない
records.en_original: Me too... This might be the worst situation.
records.en: Me too... This might be the worst situation.

records.jp: 紫乃に賛同するにせよ、止めるにせよ、<CR>どちらかを強く想えてる状態じゃない
records.en_original: Whether I agree with Shino or want to stop her, I don't feel strongly about either side now.
records.en: Whether I agree with Shino or want to stop her, I don't feel strongly about either side now.

records.jp: どちらが正しいかわからない、<CR>曖昧で不安定な、中途半端な想い
records.en_original: I don't know which is right. My feelings on this are halfhearted and unstable.
records.en: I don't know which is right. My feelings on this are halfhearted and unstable.

records.jp: いったい、どうすれば……
records.en_original: What are we supposed to do?
records.en: What are we supposed to do?

records.jp: ……お姉ちゃん
records.en_original: ...My sister.
records.en: ...My sister.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: お姉ちゃんと、モモさんの想い。<CR>二人の想いも、きっとここにあると思う
records.en_original: My sister's and Momo's feelings. I'm sure both of them are here too.
records.en: My sister's and Momo's feelings. I'm sure both of them are here too.

records.jp: 二人の想いに触れたら、多分今よりいい方向に<CR>向かうんじゃないかなって、そう思うの
records.en_original: If we touch their emotions, I think things will turn out even better than they are now.
records.en: If we touch their emotions, I think things will turn out even better than they are now.

records.jp: ……こんな時までお姉ちゃんたちに甘えるのは、<CR>良くないと思うんだけど
records.en_original: I know I shouldn't just rely on my sister and the others, even at a time like this.
records.en: I know I shouldn't just rely on my sister and the others, even at a time like this.

records.jp: でも陽桜莉に頼られてるって知ったら、<CR>美弦さんはすごく喜びそうだけど
records.en_original: But if Mio knew you were counting on her, I bet she'd be really happy.
records.en: But if Mio knew you were counting on her, I bet she'd be really happy.

records.jp: それにこの状況じゃ、あの二人の想いを頼るのは<CR>間違いじゃないと思う
records.en_original: And given what's going on, I don't think it's wrong to depend on both of their feelings.
records.en: And given what's going on, I don't think it's wrong to depend on both of their feelings.

records.jp: 前の世界からバディだった、二人の強い想いにね
records.en_original: They were partners in the previous world—their bond is super strong.
records.en: They were partners in the previous world—their bond is super strong.

records.jp: うん。お姉ちゃんたちの想い、探しに行こう
records.en_original: Yeah. Let's go search for their feelings.
records.en: Yeah. Let's go search for their feelings.
